name: crypto-watch-weekly-snapshot
description: Weekly crypto market snapshot posted to #crypto-watch. Splits into top 10 whales (by market cap) and top 10 accessible risers (under $5 price, filtered by volume and 30-day performance).

steps.code: $whales = $json.map(c => ({ name: c.name, symbol: c.symbol.toUpperCase(), price: c.current_price, mcap: c.market_cap, vol24h: c.total_volume, change30d: c.price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency }));

$risers = $json.filter(c => c.current_price > 0 && c.current_price <= 5 && c.total_volume > 1000000 && c.price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency !== null).sort((a, b) => b.price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency - a.price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency).slice(0, 10).map(c => ({ name: c.name, symbol: c.symbol.toUpperCase(), price: c.current_price, mcap: c.market_cap, vol24h: c.total_volume, change30d: c.price_change_percentage_30d_in_currency }));

const fmt = n => n ? n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 }) : 'n/a'; const fmtPct = n => n ? n.toFixed(2) + '%' : 'n/a'; const lines = [`**Weekly Crypto Watch — ${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}**`, '', 'No recommendations. Just stats from CoinGecko.', '', '### 🐋 Whale Watch — Top 10 by Market Cap', ...$whales.map((c, i) => `${i+1}. **${c.name} (${c.symbol})** — $${fmt(c.price)} | 30d: ${fmtPct(c.change30d)} | Vol 24h: $${fmt(c.vol24h)} | Mcap: $${fmt(c.mcap)}`), '', '### 🌱 Accessible Risers — Top 10 under $5 by 30-day % gain', ...$risers.map((c, i) => `${i+1}. **${c.name} (${c.symbol})** — $${fmt(c.price)} | 30d: ${fmtPct(c.change30d)} | Vol 24h: $${fmt(c.vol24h)} | Mcap: $${fmt(c.mcap)}`), '', '**What to do with this:**', '- Whale Watch = liquidity, lower spread cost, cleaner charts.', '- Accessible Risers = more units per dollar, but higher risk and slippage.', '- Both lists are starting points for your own research, not buy signals.']; $message = lines.join('\n');
